newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt overnight rates tend up, one week steady.
newsitem.headline: Egypt overnight rates tend up, one week steady.

text.p: Egyptian pound overnight interbank rates ruled on Tuesday in a tight private sector market at between 10-7/16 and 11-1/4 percent versus Monday's range of 10-1/2 and 11 percent, bankers said.
Several bankers said they did not make any one-week deals on the pound but some said rates were unchanged at 10-5/8 and 11-1/8 percent.
They said the market was inexplicably short despite a 700 million pound ($206 million) Central Bank repo which is valid for four days from Sunday.
Public sector banks maintained their minimum overnight lending rates at 10-1/2 percent.
